name: B10-0037/2024 (ECR) – Situation in Venezuela
title: Resolution on the situation in Venezuela
part_text:
The European Parliament says the July 2024 election in Venezuela was not free or fair. It recognises opposition candidate Edmundo González Urrutia as the legitimate elected president, not Nicolás Maduro. It asks European Union countries to take the same position. It condemns the arrests, deaths and repression after the vote, and calls for the release of political prisoners. It also asks for sanctions on those responsible for human rights abuses and for the voting records to be published. This is the Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament backs González as Venezuela's elected president and urges European Union countries to do the same.
- It calls for sanctions on Venezuelan officials responsible for repression and for all political prisoners to be freed.
- It asks for the full voting records to be published and for the ban on opposition figures to be lifted.
